messages:
Lina (HydraEnergy): hey all :wave: kicking off HydraEnergy onboarding. POC is Lina. Goals: 1) auto-generate short incident summaries for SCADA alerts, 2) provide vector search over 6 months of telemetry, 3) pilot at 1k req/day and measure cost delta. Need owners, success criteria, and a lean 30/60/90.

Marta (CSM): welcome Lina 1 I will coordinate CS and acceptance tests. Quick Q: any hard SLAs that affect renewal?

Lina (HydraEnergy): yes  renewal tied to summary accuracy >=92% on our gold prompts and P95 latency <600ms. Also EU data residency is required.

Noah (Solutions Eng): Ill lead the integration. Recommend chat for summaries + embeddings for search. Ask: token average per event? peak events/min?

Lina (HydraEnergy): avg ~260 tokens/event, peaks ~1.5k events/min during storms. Sample payload + schema uploaded to S3 (link in calendar invite). Region: eu-west.

Priya (Enablement): enablement plan: day 2 hands-on dev workshop, day 12 ops/runbook handoff, plus short recording. Ill publish a pre-read with IAM and allowlist steps.

Sanjay (Security): flag: retention and per-request auditability. Marta  capture whether deletion-on-request is required and whether exports need immutability. Might push to Private if audit windows conflict.

Becca (Product): product asks: summaries should surface severity and suggested next action (one-line). Can we include structured tags in outputs? Add to acceptance criteria pls.

Marta (CSM): drafting success criteria: - Summary accuracy >=92% on gold set, - P95 latency <600ms, - Structured tags (severity/action) present in >=95% outputs, - Stable 1k req/day with <0.5% errors, - EU residency + compliance sign-off.

Noah (Solutions Eng): proposed tech milestones:
Week 1: creds, allowlist, smoke test (auth curl)
Week 2: ingestion + embeddings + baseline evals
Week 3: prompt + structured-output tuning, latency optimizations
Week 4: canary pilot + monitoring + runbook handoff

Ill add a quantization pass for cost testing after pilot if needed.

Noah (Solutions Eng): smoke curl for test: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <KEY>" -d '{"model":"rwd-chat-1","input":"Summarize SCADA alert for turbine 42"}'`  please run from your infra and confirm egress.

Marta (CSM): proposing kickoff Fri 09:00 CET or Mon 11:00 CET. Which works for everyone? Ill invite eng lead, security, product, and infra.

Lina (HydraEnergy): Fri 09:00 CET works. Attendees: Lina, Omar (Eng lead), Sanjay, Becca, Noah, Priya, Marta.

cal-bot: Meeting created: Fri 09:00 CET  "HydraEnergy  Redwood Onboarding Kickoff". Invite sent.

Marta (CSM): action items from CS: collect allowlist IPs, sample S3 payload, legal contact, and finalize acceptance tests. Anything else to surface now?

Lina (HydraEnergy): risk: compressed binary telemetry may need extra parsing; will attach decompression script. Also worried about hallucinated timestamps in summaries  will include curated prompts to catch that.

Sanjay (Security): also note: if we must retain per-request outputs for >12 months for audit, well need to discuss Private deployment. Capturing as a potential renewal blocker.

Priya (Enablement): Ill post the pre-read in the calendar invite with the gold prompt set and required IAM roles. Will record the dev session and share.

Noah (Solutions Eng): Ill open a tech ticket for the eval harness and post a minimal CI script for running the gold set against the dev endpoint.

Marta (CSM): great 1 Ill post the action tracker after the invite. See you Fri. :rocket:
